item.title: Yemen and the Red Sea: the situation
item.description:

Saudi Arabia dismissed its coalition commander as anti-Houthi forces pulled back from the strait and other key areas, while Saudi-backed forces have intensified attacks, striking dozens of Houthi military sites and increasing pressure on Taiz. The Yemeni parliament passed a law designating the Houthis as terrorists, raising concerns about a resurgence by southern separatists. Reuters reports Saudi Arabia is preparing a Yemen campaign that could extend into 2027. The conflict caused 918 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

Political tension is evident as Machar urged a special court to deploy unified forces to Nasir before the 2025 clashes and the Juba City Council imposed a 10 million SSP fine for selling alcohol to minors.
